1b894dc84880cf9f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه اعمار المدن عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المعماري مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة، والإشراف على التعديلات والإضافات للمباني القائمة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الاستشارات المتعلقة بترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. يشمل الدور أيضاً المساعدة في اختيار المواقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين وتحديد المواد المناسبة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. نبحث عن مرشح لديه القدرة على تطبيق المعرفة الهندسية في تصميم وتنفيذ المشاريع المختلفة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. ملخص الدور يقوم المهندس المعماري بتصميم وإدارة المشاريع المعمارية، من التصميم الأولي إلى الإشراف على التنفيذ، مع التركيز على الجودة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. يتضمن الدور أيضاً التواصل الفعال مع الفرق الداخلية والمقاولين لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركه اعمار المدن في هذا الدور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

1be66232301d15f9.description: About the Role Cander is seeking a Head of Treasury to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is ideal for a KSA National, preferably SAMA Approved, with 5-10 years of experience in financial services. The Head of Treasury will be responsible for robust cash flow management, inter-bank and customer deposit resource management, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and risk parameters. Key Responsibilities Ensure robust cash flow management processes to enhance liquidity and support strategic decision-making. Manage inter-bank and customer deposit resources of the group, adhering to risk appetite and parameters determined by the Board. Establish processes and procedures to conduct operations in line with regulatory requirements. Support treasury planning, forecasting, and management reporting by designing reporting requirements for integration into the ERP system. Treasury Development and Integration Develop and implement treasury planning and forecasting processes to support organizational objectives. Design reporting requirements for the ERP system, including segmentation, channel, products, customer base, front and back book margins, average balance sheet, KPIs, and cost classification (fixed, variable, onboarding/acquisition, and servicing). Integrate robust cash flow management processes into the ERP system to ensure financial stability and strategic decision-making. Operational Management Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of treasury activities with business needs. Monitor treasury performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to enhance efficiency. Manage the bank's liquidity situation at all times and ensure appropriate emergency plans are in place. Provide training and awareness programs to stakeholders on treasury processes. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to continuously improve treasury processes. Ensure timely preparation for treasury planning (including liquidity and funding) aligned with operational needs. Compliance and Risk Management Ensure compliance with liquidity constraints, company policies, and industry standards. Develop and maintain treasury policies and procedures to enhance efficiency and control. Supervise FX activities and manage Money Market positions within established limits and in compliance with risk management guidelines. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a treasury role within the financial services sector. KSA Candidate, ideally SAMA Approved. Demonstrated experience in cash flow management, liquidity management, and regulatory compliance. Strong understanding of ERP system integration for financial reporting.

1bf4e84ff1339ffa.company_name: شركة نبراس الهدي للسفر و السياحة
1bf4e84ff1339ffa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث المستشفى السعودي الألماني فرع شركة الشرق الأوسط للرعاية الصحية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى تحديث بيانات الموظفين والتعامل مع استفساراتهم. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية إلى ضمان التطبيق الفعال لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بالحضور، الإجازات، الترقيات، وإنهاء الخدمة. كما يتولى مسؤولية إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة لدعم عمليات الموارد البشرية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى، ملاحظات، طلبات، واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة بفاعلية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق بدقة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل المستشفى السعودي الألماني، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

1b7cb80985aea10d.description: Description Tuwaiq Casting & Forging is seeking an experienced and technically strong IT Infrastructure Manager to join the IT Department. Reporting to the IT Director, this role is responsible for planning, implementing, managing, and securing the organisation's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, cloud platforms, storage systems, cybersecurity solutions, and communication systems. The role ensures high availability, reliability, and security of all IT services while supporting business operations and digital transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Management Manage enterprise network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewalls Oversee server environments, virtualisation platforms, and cloud services Manage Microsoft 365 and cloud infrastructure Ensure optimal performance, availability, and capacity planning of IT systems Maintain storage solutions, backup systems, and disaster recovery sites Manage data centre and server room infrastructure Manage IP telephony and communication systems. Cybersecurity & Compliance Implement and maintain IT security controls and policies Manage firewalls, endpoint protection, access controls, and vulnerability remediation Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, IT policies, and regulatory requirements Conduct risk assessments and security reviews. Operations & Support Ensure 24/7 availability of critical IT services Lead incident management and problem resolution activities Monitor infrastructure health and system performance Manage system upgrades, patches, and technology refresh initiatives. Team Leadership Lead and mentor system administrators, network engineers, and IT support staff Assign tasks, monitor performance, and support staff development Promote best practices and continuous improvement within the IT team. 1bcad616533260ab.description: Nova® Water is Saudi Arabia’s most iconic premium bottled water brand, recognized for its uncompromising quality and continuous innovation. As the Kingdom’s leading water brand, Nova® has earned the trust of consumers nationwide and remains a symbol of purity and pride. Rooted in the heart of this land, Nova® continues to set the benchmark for hydration and brand excellence in Saudi Arabia. Job Purpose: To oversee and execute the branch's accounting operations, ensuring accurate management of accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger activities, inventory reconciliations, cash management, and financial reporting. The role is responsible for maintaining strong financial controls, ensuring timely collections and vendor payments, supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, and ensuring compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements while providing financial insights to support operational and business objectives. Key Responsibilities: Accounts Receivable Management Record and reconcile all customer collections, deposits, and bank transfers. Monitor daily accounts receivable aging and communicate outstanding balances, blocked customers, and credit limit utilization to branch management. Follow up with sales supervisors and branch management regarding overdue collections and customers exceeding approved credit limits. Ensure timely allocation of collections against outstanding invoices. Obtain customer balance confirmations and perform reconciliations to ensure accuracy of receivable balances. Provide monthly customer statements and support collection efforts to improve cash flow. Monitor compliance with credit control procedures, including signed and stamped invoices. Ensure cash customer balances and unapplied receipts are cleared in a timely manner. Accounts Payable Management Oversee the end-to-end accounts payable process including invoice verification, coding, posting, and payment processing. Review and post supplier invoices in SAP, ensuring accurate allocation to General Ledger accounts and cost centers. Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies promptly. Monitor supplier aging reports and ensure payments are made within agreed credit terms. Coordinate with procurement, operations, and vendors to resolve invoice and payment-related issues. Ensure compliance with procurement policies, tax regulations, and internal controls. General Ledger & Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and supporting analyses. Manage General Ledger accounts through accurate journal entries and reconciliations. Perform monthly bank reconciliations and investigate reconciling items. Execute month-end and year-end closing activities within reporting deadlines. Reconcile subsidiary ledgers with General Ledger balances on a monthly basis. Analyze financial transactions and ensure accounting records are complete and accurate. Inventory & Asset Control Conduct periodic inventory counts and ensure timely reconciliation of inventory variances. Support stock-taking exercises and inventory audits across the branch. Monitor and reconcile inventory-related transactions and reports. Maintain the Fixed Asset Register and ensure accurate asset capitalization and depreciation. Supervise scrap sales accounting, collection recording, and reconciliation processes. Cash & Expense Management Manage petty cash funds, replenishment requests, and reconciliations. Review employee expense claims and ensure compliance with company policies. Monitor branch cash balances and ensure proper documentation and controls are maintained. Compliance & Internal Controls Ensure compliance with VAT, ZATCA, company policies, and accounting procedures. Support internal and external audit activities by providing required documentation and explanations. Implement and maintain effective internal controls to safeguard company assets. Ensure proper financial document archiving and record retention practices. Financial Planning & Analysis Support budgeting and forecasting processes. Analyze budget variances and identify financial risks and opportunities. Provide financial insights and recommendations to improve branch profitability and operational performance. Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certifications such as SOCPA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent are preferred. 4-7 years of progressive accounting experience. Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, distribution, or supply chain environments is preferred. Strong experience in both Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable functions.

1b07aab4848010e2.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة مصانع الخليج العربي للصناعات البلاستيكية والمطاطية عن مدير عمليات أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تطوير وتنفيذ وإدارة منظومة أمنية متكاملة لحماية موظفي الشركة وزوارها ومرافقها وأصولها ومنتجاتها وموادها الخام ومعلوماتها وعملياتها التشغيلية من التهديدات الأمنية، والدخول غير المصرح به، والسرقة، والتلف، والفقدان، وغيرها من المخاطر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على أنظمة المراقبة بالكاميرات (CCTV) وأنظمة التحكم بالدخول والخروج. تنظيم دخول وخروج الموظفين والزوار والمقاولين والمركبات، والتحقق من التصاريح والهويات. حماية الأصول والمواد الخام والمنتجات والمعدات من السرقة أو الفقد أو التلف، وتطبيق إجراءات منع الخسائر. إجراء التحقيقات الأولية في الحوادث والمخالفات الأمنية، وتوثيق الأدلة وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. تقييم المخاطر الأمنية وتحديد الثغرات، ووضع الإجراءات الوقائية والتصحيحية المناسبة. إعداد وتطبيق السياسات والإجراءات والتعليمات الأمنية ومتابعة الالتزام بها. إعداد خطط الاستجابة للحوادث والطوارئ الأمنية، والتنسيق مع إدارة الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) والجهات المختصة. تنفيذ الجولات والتفتيشات الأمنية الدورية على البوابات والأسوار والمستودعات ومناطق الإنتاج. التنسيق مع الإدارات الداخلية وشركات الحراسات الأمنية ومزودي الأنظمة الأمنية لضمان كفاءة العمليات. إعداد التقارير الأمنية الدورية ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs)، ومتابعة الحوادث والإجراءات التصحيحية. تدريب وتوعية أفراد الأمن والموظفين بالإجراءات الأمنية ومتطلبات حماية الأصول والإبلاغ عن الحوادث. متابعة أداء أفراد الأمن وشركات الحراسة المتعاقدة، ورفع التوصيات اللازمة لتحسين مستوى الأمن. الإشراف على فريق الأمن التابع له، ومتابعة أدائه والتزامه بالمهام والإجراءات الأمنية المعتمدة، وتوزيع المسؤوليات ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم الأداء، ومعالجة أوجه القصور، وضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة أمنية لا تقل عن 8 سنوات، منها 3 سنوات على الأقل في منصب إداري أو إشرافي. تُفضل الخبرة في المصانع والمنشآت الصناعية، مع خبرة في إدارة الحراسات والورديات وحماية الأصول. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. الراتب الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولم يتم الإفصاح عنه في الوقت الحالي. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على هذه الوظيفة، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

1b0d5a39ae1ebfac.job_title: HR Compliance & Global Mobility Operations Manager
1b0d5a39ae1ebfac.description: About Alvarez & Marsal Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm recognized for its entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach to client problem-solving. The firm emphasizes a hands-on method to assist clients in realizing their potential. A&M's culture values independent thinkers who positively impact clients and the industry, fostering a collaborative environment guided by core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. The role serves as the primary point of contact for global mobility and contracts across designated Middle East jurisdictions, with an initial focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Responsibilities include coordinating international assignments, managing immigration requirements, and drafting employment contracts in compliance with local labor laws and company policies. The ideal candidate is fluent in Arabic and English and can manage related matters with limited oversight, partnering with HR, Legal, business leaders, and external service providers. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary operational point of contact for global mobility matters across the Middle East. Manage the end-to-end global mobility process, including international relocations, assignments, transfers, and repatriation. Coordinate visa applications, work permits, residency permits, and other immigration-related requirements. Monitor immigration status and document-expiry dates, tracking application progress and resolving issues. Ensure compliance with applicable immigration laws, local regulations, and company policies. Maintain accurate employee mobility records, assignment documentation, and immigration status updates. Draft, review, and prepare employment contracts, offer letters, and related documentation for employees in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Ensure employment contracts align with applicable local labor laws, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Prepare and review employment documentation in both Arabic and English, ensuring accuracy and consistency. Serve as a key contact for employment contract inquiries, providing guidance to HR teams and stakeholders. Handle personal, immigration, and employment information confidentially and in accordance with data-protection requirements. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience in global mobility and employment contracts. Fluency in both Arabic and English is required. Ability to manage mobility and contract-related matters with limited oversight. Strong understanding of local labor laws and regulatory requirements in the Middle East, particularly Saudi Arabia and UAE. Experience in coordinating international assignments and relocations. Proficiency in drafting and reviewing legal and contractual documentation. The firm promotes continuous learning and professional development through robust performance processes, training, and on-the-job learning opportunities. A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide its operations, emphasizing impact and integrity in all endeavors. 1b7d83b9070e3086.description: About the Role ASMO is seeking an Inventory Controller to manage and monitor inventory activities at its Jazan site in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring accurate inventory records, efficient material flow, and effective stock control across site operations. The Inventory Controller will support the site operations team by maintaining inventory accuracy, monitoring stock levels, and coordinating with logistics and procurement to ensure material availability. Role Context The role operates within an active operational environment that involves material handling, equipment operations, and continuous logistics movements. Close coordination with site teams is essential to maintain operational efficiency and inventory visibility. The Inventory Controller will be responsible for preventing shortages or excess inventory and ensuring that materials are available to support operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate records of all inventory transactions at the Jazan site, including receipts, storage, transfers, and dispatch activities. Monitor daily inventory levels to ensure stock availability and prevent shortages or excess inventory. Coordinate with site operations and logistics teams to ensure timely movement and availability of materials required for operational activities. Conduct regular inventory counts, cycle counts, and physical stock verification to ensure alignment between system records and physical inventory. Investigate inventory discrepancies and support the implementation of corrective actions to improve inventory accuracy. Maintain proper documentation and tracking of materials within the inventory management system. Coordinate with procurement and supply chain teams regarding material requirements, replenishment plans, and inventory status updates. Monitor and report inventory-related KPIs, including stock accuracy, inventory turnover, and stock availability. Support the preparation of periodic inventory reports and provide insights to site management regarding stock movement and material utilization. Assist in implementing inventory management processes and systems to improve operational efficiency and inventory visibility. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or an equivalent field from a recognized and accredited university. 0-3 years of experience in a similar or related field. Experience in inventory management and stock control within operational or industrial environments. Knowledge and experience operating on SAP or an equivalent Warehouse Management System. Exposure to site operations, warehouse management, or logistics activities is preferred. Work Environment This role is based at the ASMO Jazan site and involves working within an active operational environment. The position requires close collaboration with various site teams, including operations, logistics, and procurement, to ensure seamless inventory management and operational support. Application Information We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1bbf6d72695759b1.description: نبذة عن الدور تُقدم فرصة تدريب كـ متدرب تصميم جرافيكي في الرياض، مع التركيز على تصميم الأثاث والمطابخ. هذا الدور مخصص للأفراد الذين لديهم شغف بالتصميم ويرغبون في تطوير مهاراتهم ضمن بيئة مهنية. سيتيح للمتدرب العمل على مشاريع حقيقية والمساهمة في تحسين تجربة العملاء من خلال تصميمات مميزة. الفرصة التدريبية تُعد هذه الفرصة مثالية للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التصميم. سيتمكن المتدرب من تعلم كيفية استخدام أدوات التصميم الحديثة مثل Adobe Photoshop وIllustrator، واكتساب مهارات عملية في تصميم الأثاث والمطابخ. سيتم توفير التدريب والدعم اللازمين لتوسيع المهارات الفنية والإبداعية، مع إتاحة الفرصة للعمل جنبًا إلى جنب مع مصممين محترفين. المهام والمسؤوليات المشاركة في تصميم المواد التسويقية مثل الكتيبات والبروشورات باستخدام برامج التصميم مثل Adobe Illustrator وPhotoshop. إنشاء تصاميم جرافيكية لمواقع التواصل الاجتماعي لتعزيز التفاعل وزيادة الوعي بالعلامة التجارية. التعاون مع فريق التسويق لفهم احتياجات العملاء وتطوير تصاميم تلبي تلك الاحتياجات. مراجعة التصاميم وتقديم الاقتراحات للتحسين. المشاركة في جلسات العصف الذهني لتوليد أفكار جديدة ومبتكرة. تطوير محتوى مرئي جذاب يعكس هوية الشركة وقيمها. تنظيم الملفات والتصاميم بطريقة تسهل الوصول إليها. مواكبة الاتجاهات الحديثة في تصميم الجرافيك والتكنولوجيا. تقديم الدعم في إعداد العروض التقديمية والتقارير. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التصميم الجرافيكي. شغف بالتصميم ورغبة في تطوير المهارات في بيئة مهنية. القدرة على تقديم أفكار جديدة ومبتكرة في مجال التصميم. الرغبة في التعلم المستمر واكتساب مهارات في تصميم الأثاث والمطابخ. بيئة العمل تُقدر الشركة ثقافة العمل الجماعي وتوفر بيئة تشجع على الإبداع والتعاون. يركز الفريق على الابتكار ويؤمن بتطوير المواهب الشابة، ويسعى لمساعدة المتدربين على تحقيق أهدافهم المهنية من خلال توفير الدعم والتوجيه المناسبين. تفاصيل إضافية هذا الدور هو تدريب مدفوع الأجر، يتراوح الراتب بين 1,875 ريال سعودي و 3,750 ريال سعودي. تُعد هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمرشحين المقيمين في الرياض والذين يبحثون عن بداية مهنية في مجال التصميم الجرافيكي.

1bfcc81e085bba15.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an IT Disaster Recovery and Availability Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on ensuring the resilience and continuous operation of IT services. The role requires flexibility, including availability to work on weekends for Disaster Recovery (DR) execution activities. Disaster Recovery Responsibilities Participate in Disaster Recovery Governance & Planning. Maintain and periodically review the inventory of critical business and IT services for DR planning and testing. Manage the annual Disaster Recovery and High Availability testing calendar. Ensure DR plans align with business continuity requirements and regulatory obligations. Ensure ITSCM plans, risks, controls, and activities remain aligned with business continuity requirements. Assess continuity risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Lead end-to-end Disaster Recovery and High Availability testing activities. Coordinate pre-test planning, stakeholder communications, execution workshops, and test rehearsals. Manage test windows and bridge calls. Monitor runbook execution and ensure successful completion of recovery activities. Coordinate evidence collection, issue tracking, risk logging, and post-test reviews. Prepare executive-level DR testing reports and recommendations. Facilitate coordination between technical teams, business stakeholders, management, and external vendors. Participate in crisis management and business continuity response activities. Availability Management Responsibilities Execute and govern the Availability Management process in line with agreed SLAs, OLAs, and service commitments. Establish and maintain service availability baselines and performance targets. Conduct regular service availability reviews with stakeholders. Monitor availability, uptime, and downtime of all applications and infrastructure services utilizing approved monitoring tools. Validate availability calculations and ensure data integrity across reporting platforms. Generate daily, weekly, and executive-level availability reports. Analyze service outages, performance degradation, availability trends, and recurring failures. Identify risks affecting service availability and develop mitigation plans. Recommend service reliability and resilience improvements. Validate exclusion of approved downtime from SLA calculations. Conduct service review meetings and availability governance discussions. Define monitoring requirements, availability targets, reporting standards, and governance controls for new services. Identify opportunities to improve service availability and operational efficiency. Drive root cause trending and proactive improvement initiatives. Submit recommendations to CSI governance boards. Measure effectiveness of implemented improvements. Enhance availability analytics using Power BI, ServiceNow, Dynatrace, SiteScope, SCOM, SolarWinds, or equivalent monitoring tools. Reduce manual effort through automation of KPI reporting and trend analysis. Key Performance Indicators DR and HA testing completion rate. DR testing success rate. Achievement of agreed RTO and RPO targets. Closure rate of DR findings and lessons learned. DR readiness compliance score. IT service availability percentage. SLA compliance achievement. Completion of availability improvement initiatives. Automation and reporting efficiency improvements. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position. The successful candidate must be flexible and available to work on weekends when Disaster Recovery execution is required.

1b764246ddb3fea3.job_title: Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
1b764246ddb3fea3.description: The KH Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist is responsible for overseeing the financial operations and revenue cycle management of KAUST Health, ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective budget management, and efficient insurance claims processing. The role focuses on validating invoices and quotations, managing end-to-end insurance claim activities, monitoring financial performance, and optimizing revenue collection while ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and healthcare regulations. Working closely with healthcare operators, insurance providers, finance teams, and senior leadership, the specialist plays a key role in improving financial sustainability, minimizing claim denials, strengthening financial controls, and supporting strategic decision-making through data-driven financial analysis and reporting. Key Responsibilities Review and validate invoices submitted by the healthcare operator to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual agreements before payment approval. Evaluate and approve quotations for healthcare services by verifying pricing, scope, and alignment with agreed contracts and organizational policies. Lead the annual budgeting process, including budget preparation, monitoring, forecasting, and expenditure control to support KAUST Health's financial objectives. Prepare financial reports and conduct variance analysis, providing monthly financial insights, forecasting, and recommendations to improve operational and financial performance. Manage the end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process, ensuring timely and accurate submission of insurance claims to all insurance providers. Validate insurance claims by reviewing billing accuracy, medical coding, documentation, and compliance with payer requirements to minimize claim denials. Monitor claim rejections, collections, and reimbursement performance, analyze denial trends, implement corrective actions, and improve cash flow and revenue recovery. Lead reconciliation meetings with healthcare operators and insurance companies to resolve payment discrepancies, outstanding claims, billing issues, and account reconciliations. Develop and present financial and revenue cycle KPIs to senior leadership, identifying financial risks, revenue optimization opportunities, and process improvement initiatives. Ensure financial compliance and stakeholder collaboration by supporting internal and external audits, maintaining compliance with financial policies and healthcare regulations, and serving as the primary liaison between KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline (Finance or Accounting preferred). Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management is preferred. Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent is considered an added advantage. Minimum of 6 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership or specialist role in finance, healthcare finance, or revenue cycle management. Proven experience in healthcare finance, including budgeting, financial planning, financial reporting, cost control, and expenditure management within hospitals or healthcare organizations. Extensive knowledge of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), including insurance claims processing, claim validation, reimbursement, denial management, collections, and financial reconciliation. Strong financial analysis and reporting skills, with experience in budget preparation, forecasting, variance analysis, KPI reporting, and financial performance management. Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, financial modeling, dashboards, data analysis, and reporting; experience with ERP or healthcare financial systems is highly desirable.
